title: Refreshed Buddies
description: Old friends in a brand new style!
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce5173d4b136c3bccec04a67d8c38b78504c376c_0.webp)

Refreshed Buddies gives some of Minecraft’s classic mobs a fresh new look while keeping their original charm.

Old familiar faces return with redesigned models, updated textures, and a style that still feels like it belongs in the game.

A simple visual refresh for players who want their old friends to feel new again.

**Old friends in a brand new style!**

## Requirements

This resource pack requires:

- [Entity Model Features - EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
- [Entity Texture Features - ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
